metadata.title: Solar Flare Portrait with Distressed Sans-Serif

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast portrait bathed in a fiery red-to-yellow gradient with heavy lens flare and vertically stacked, distressed block typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered male portrait obscured by a powerful diagonal yellow light leak, set against a deep red background. The composition is framed by large, white, distressed sans-serif text running vertically on the left and horizontally at the bottom right.
coreVisualRelationships: Light leak bisecting the subject's face diagonally
High-contrast warm color gradient (Red to Yellow)
Textured halftone patterns within the white typography
Subject's gaze directed at the viewer through the flare
coreInvariants: Distressed/weathered texture on all text elements
Strong diagonal light source from the right

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, centered horizontally, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow light flare on the right side of the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright flare, moves left to the vertical text, then down to the horizontal text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; filled with color gradients and light artifacts.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with extreme value contrast between the deep red shadows and blown-out yellow highlights.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Halftone dot pattern applied as a mask to the fill
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in two orientations (vertical and horizontal) to create a frame.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and vertical presence.
Matches the wide geometric structure of the horizontal text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with medium-length hair, lit by a powerful diagonal yellow lens flare coming from the right. Apply a deep red to orange gradient wash over the entire image. The right side should be nearly blown out with yellow light.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, heavy, wide sans-serif text. One string should run vertically along the left edge, rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise. A second string should be placed horizontally at the bottom right. Apply a white halftone texture and distressed erosion effect to all text.

verificationChecks: Is the text heavily distressed with a halftone pattern?
Is there a strong diagonal yellow light leak?
Is the color palette strictly warm (red/orange/yellow)?
Is the vertical text oriented correctly along the left edge?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Verify text is uppercase and wide-bodied
Ensure the halftone texture is visible in the white areas
Check that the light flare interacts with the subject's face
Confirm the vertical text is rotated 270 degrees
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Diagonal Yellow Flare + Red Gradient Wash + Distressed Wide Sans-Serif Frame
